h: The Four Forms of Peace That Hold Shabbos Blessing

p: may He place upon us blessing and peace."
This is based on what they said (end of Uktzin):
"The Holy One, blessed be He, found
no vessel that holds blessing for Yisrael
of necessity this is through the vessel
that holds blessing, which is peace.
And in the Pesikta at the end of this haftarah:
שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאוֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶיךָ (תְּהִלִּים קיט, קסה)
'Great peace have those who love Your Torah' (Tehillim 119:165);
'In his days let the righteous flourish,
וְרוֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד בְּלִי יָרֵחַ (תְּהִלִּים עב, ז)
and abundance of peace till the moon be no more' (Tehillim 72:7);
'And all your children shall be taught of Hashem,
and great shall be the peace of your children' (Yeshayahu 54:13);
'But the humble shall inherit the land
וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל רֹב שָׁלוֹם (תְּהִלִּים לז, יא)
and delight in abundance of peace' (Tehillim 37:11)."
Now, it listed three pesukim from Tehillim,
and among them, as the third pasuk, one from Yeshayahu,
for the first pasuk is from psalm 119,
and the fourth pasuk from Tehillim 37;
It seems that the Pesikta listed here
כְּנֶגֶד ד׳ הַמִּדּוֹת שֶׁל קַו הָאֶמְצָעִי
corresponding to the four attributes of the middle line:
and they are the four holinesses of Shabbos,
which are the Field of Holy Apples,
Ze'ir Anpin and the Holy Ancient One
which are the holinesses of the three Shabbos meals,
as is written in the holy Zohar
and the holiness of Tzaddik, Foundation of the World,
which is counted in the Zohar Chadash (Parshas Toldos):
מוּסַף שַׁבָּת לָקֳבֵל צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם
"the Musaf of Shabbos corresponds to Tzaddik, Foundation of the World";
for the added holiness of Shabbos
corresponds to the holiness of Yosef HaTzaddik.
And as for peace, it is known
is from the accusation of the evil inclination,
"There is no peace in my bones because of my sin";
He will make him at peace with you";
"And I will give peace in the land,
and you shall lie down and none shall make you afraid."
the meaning is that it will be completely rectified,
and there will be peace entirely;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
And as they said in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 88a):
on the Holy Ancient One, on Ze'ir Anpin
and on the Field of Holy Apples";
and "body and covenant are counted as one"
(as is written in the holy Zohar everywhere);
and they are the four holinesses of Shabbos,
And likewise there is a reading in the Pesikta
כַּסֵּדֶר ד׳ קְדוּשּׁוֹת שֶׁל קַו הָאֶמְצָעִי
in the order of the four holinesses of the middle line.
The first, "Great peace have those who love Your Torah"
זֶה מוּסָב עַל כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
this refers to every one of Yisrael,
for in truth every one of Yisrael
רוֹצֶה לִהְיוֹת מֵעוֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם
wants to be among those who do the will of the Omnipresent,
"Our will is to do Your will";
and the will of the Omnipresent is
that a person be completely free for Torah,
according to the view of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַרְנוּ בְּמַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (שָׁם לה, ב)
and as we said on what they said (there, 35b):
בִּזְמַן שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל עוֹשִׂין רְצוֹנוֹ שֶׁל מָקוֹם
"When Yisrael do the will of the Omnipresent,
their work is done by others";
for in the passage "And it shall be, if you listen"
and the mitzvah of Hashem was
but the will of the Omnipresent was
that a person be a toiler in the Torah,
be only in words of Torah;
and this is the will of the Omnipresent.
And this is the meaning of "Our will is to do Your will":
to be free only for words of Torah;
The leaven in the dough and the subjugation of the kingdoms,"
with the distractions of this world.
And therefore every one of Yisrael is called
"Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the water,"
about a student who is not worthy,
and has a longing for words of Torah,
for "our will is to do Your will."
And this is "Great peace have those who love Your Torah,
and they have no stumbling block":
that Hashem Yisbarach will help him
against the leaven in the dough,
וְזֶה נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת חֲקַל תַּפּוּחִין קַדִּישִׁין
And this corresponds to the holiness of the Field of Holy Apples,
And the second, "In his days let the righteous flourish,"
הוּא כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם
corresponds to the holiness of Tzaddik, Foundation of the World,
as is written in the holy Zohar;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה צא, ז)
when they fell into his hand," etc.
And the main cause of the Egyptian exile
as is written in the Zohar Chadash
that is, he said of them
that they cast their eyes on the daughters of the land;
and they knew that they were clean of this,
so they reasoned that presumably it was the reverse,
"Whoever disqualifies others does so with his own blemish";
and therefore they sold him as a slave,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה פד, יז)
"Let us go and follow the way of the world:
was he not cursed with slavery?" etc.
And Canaan's sin was in this blemish,
And afterward Yosef was proven in Egypt,
for he became a chariot for the attribute of Tzaddik,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה בֵּירֵר כָּל הַכְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
and through this he purified all of Klal Yisrael;
as they said in the Midrash
and fenced himself off from immorality,
and all the males were fenced in his merit";
And this is what it says (Bereishis 45:5):
"For God sent me before you to preserve life";
for through his withstanding the test in this,
הָיָה בְּכֹחַ כָּל הַזְּכָרִים אַחַר כָּךְ
all the males afterward had the power
to fence themselves off in the Egyptian exile.
And this is "In his days let the righteous flourish,
וְכֵן כְּתִיב בְּמִזְמוֹר שֶׁל שַׁבָּת (תְּהִלִּים צב, יג)
and likewise it is written in the psalm of Shabbos (Tehillim 92:13):
"The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree."
And the third, "And all your children shall be taught of Hashem,
and great shall be the peace of your builders,"
corresponds to the holiness of Ze'ir Anpin,
which is the sign of truth;
and it is written, "You will give truth to Yaakov."
"And all your children shall be taught of Hashem,"
"and great shall be the peace of your children"
who are called builders of the world (Shabbos 114a),
"who are occupied with the building of the world"
וְהַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
that is, through the Oral Torah
that was given over to them.
"And in His goodness He renews every day
שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם
that the Holy One, blessed be He, renews every day
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מט, ב)
and after the Giving of the Torah
the innovation of halachah was given over to the Sages,
those occupied with the building of the world,
for through them is renewed every day
"But the humble shall inherit the land,"
corresponds to the holiness of the Holy Ancient One,
the aspect of the Supernal Crown;
for one who is on the level of humility
becomes a chariot for the attribute of Ayin,
most hidden of all, who is called Ayin,"
as is written in the holy Zohar.
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who was humbler than any man,
which is the inwardness of the Supernal Crown.
And this is "But the humble shall inherit the land
and delight in abundance of peace"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (יְשַׁעְיָה נח, יד)
in the manner of what is said (Yeshayahu 58:14):
which is expounded in the holy Zohar
as referring to the attribute of Atika,
שֶׁעַל זֶה מְרַמֵּז הַתָּגוֹ שֶׁל יוּד
to this the crown-tip of the Yud alludes,
which is the shining forth from the Supernal Crown
for it is stated in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 13, 29a):
the image of the middle pillar
Rather he was from the inside;
and that one from the soul";
מִי יָקוּם יַעֲקֹב כִּי קָטֹן הוּא
"How shall Yaakov stand, for he is small"
may He place upon us blessing and peace";
for at this meal one merits
the holiness of all three Avos,
"for the daughter is crowned with the Avos,"
and the holiness of Yosef HaTzaddik,
which is the added holiness of Shabbos;
And as they said in the Mechilta:
"'And keeps his hand from doing any evil'
merits to be guarded from sin";
and in Pri Etz Chaim the wording is
that he is guarded from the accusation of the evil inclination;
